verdict.rationale: Medusa documents a built-in framework for building custom commerce applications and extensions. Evidence includes Admin Injection Zones for dashboard extensions, the Medusa UI component library, an official CLI, open-source modules published on npm, and community-noted starter kits that serve as scaffolding. However, nothing in the evidence describes a review, marketplace or distribution path for extensions, and no dedicated client SDK is explicitly documented. Missing for 10: documented extension review/distribution or marketplace path, explicit official SDK documentation, detail on CLI scaffolding commands, independent hands-on corroboration.
